note: M2 drive 2026-10-01 (Bug 2, the founder's "skip backwards didn't work during the AI narration"): the car's and the lock screen's back-15 / forward-30 / scrub inside a Foray, on the ENGINE target (reference-engine.js; EngineCore.onRemote natively). The press is the engine's own command from source remote (runner.js engineRemoteSurface), and every one is a step on the FORAY's clock: a target in a clip plays it at its offset, crossing items as needed; inside the SPOKEN line sounding, back says it again and forward goes on past it (nudgeAction); a scrub into it restarts it; a RENDERED line seeks like a clip, also in transitioning, where the reducer refuses a seek. Foray clock: s0 0-100, n1 (spoken, 32 s) 100-132, s1 132-232, n2 (rendered, 32 s) 232-264, s2 264-364. JVM: the family is owed whole to A-40 (Foray transport).
